integrity: Analytic proof supplied and a standalone fixed-seed deterministic verification program. All verification is self-review, with no independent audit or empirical validation.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two subareas, fixed common rainfall and initial-abstraction fraction, no routing or empirical calibration. The numerical reversal phenomenon itself was already documented by Paudel et al. (2009); priority is claimed only for the complete exact uniqueness/cubic/sharp-bound classification. One close 2012 full text remained inaccessible; broader implication risk remains.
title: Unique rainfall reversal of two-zone curve-number aggregation bias
